title: Fun experience
text: Elvira was a fantastic guide: kind, approachable, and very fun. She made the tour through the Gothic Quarter enjoyable and interesting, and she also gave us very good gastronomic tips for the area.
author: 130noeliah

title: Wonderful!
text:
The experience with Elvira has been fantastic. We took a tour through the Gothic Quarter and El Born, and discovered many new little things about Barcelona.
He also took us to two very delicious and authentic places for dinner.
100% recommended.
author: martacanillas98

title: A very complete tour through the historic heart of Barcelona
text:
We took a guided tour of Barcelona, traveling through the Gothic Quarter, El Raval, and part of Ciutat Vella, and the experience was fantastic. It was a very interesting way to discover the city from another perspective.

The guide explained the history of each area in a very enjoyable way, mixing historical facts, curiosities, and anecdotes that made the tour very entertaining. 

The pace of the tour was very pleasant, without rushing, with time to ask questions and enjoy the walk. Without a doubt, a highly recommended experience for those who want to get to know Barcelona in a more authentic
author: Dansmac

title: Barcelona: 5 hours tour

text: Elvira has such a wonderful mastery of everything Barcelona! author: davekZ7897IR

title: A Fantastic Private Cultural Tour of Barcelona provided by Go Local Barcelona & Elvira
text: I enthusiastically recommend Go Local Barcelona & Elvira for a private cultural tour of Barcelona.  Elvira is passionate about showing her hometown to visitors.  For our tour Elvira took us on a walking tour of the Gothic Quarter and other areas that were part of the original settlement.  Our tour was full of interesting sites and experiences.  As a private tour Elvira tailored the content to what we were most interested in seeing.  We even did some shopping at small shops owned & operated by local artisans.  Overall it was a wonderful way to spend a day in Barcelona.  We will hire Elvira agai
author: X7635YOjoed

title: A Perfect Day!
text: Elvira was amazing! She was knowledgeable, interesting, perfectly paced, and a joy to be with. Her understanding of Barcelona history is incredible, and she has a beautiful way of sharing. We enjoyed a “insiders only” tour and a lovely tapas lunch. She shared her knowledge of local food and drink, as well architecture, art, history, etc. A lovely experience all around!! I highly recommend!
author: 319mollyb

title: Personal History tour
text: What a wonderful way to learn the history of Barcelona and see the sites.  My husband and I love history and were so glad to add this to our anniversary trip.  She quickly learned things we liked and added it to the sights.  She also was kind enough to take pictures of us at the several locations.
